metadata.title: Verifiable Multi-Agent Anatomy: A Doctrine-Locked Runtime for Receipt-Bound Organisms (v14 — Math Pod V3 + Fly-High V6: Lutar Calculus, TH8-GΛR Lean Skeleton, Doctrine V6, arXiv-Ready)
metadata.description:
We present the Lutar Multi-Agent Anatomy (S), a formally verified, receipt-typed, operationally measured multi-agent runtime at production scale. The system is defined as S = (R, A, E, Lambda, rho, W) over eight canonical regions, governed by a nine-axis conjunctive quality gate Lambda_9 proved unique in Lean 4 (sorry-count = 0), and verified at 218/218 passing tests, receipt build p50 = 11.5 microseconds (62,764 ops/sec), and 100% rho-closure on 8,000/8,000 paired calls.

This v14 release introduces Math Pod V3: a five-agent operation producing fourteen pure-math upgrades, fifteen applied-numerical upgrades, and the Unified Extension — the Lambda-Calculus over the Body-Graph. New contributions: (1) TH6 — Bekenstein entropy bound proved via data processing inequality (discharging conjectured A7); (2) TH7 — Curry-Howard receipt calculus (receipts-as-proofs); (3) TH4 — Lambda-Category composability (categorical semantics for TH1); (4) TH5 — Receipt chain confluence (cofree comonad formalization of replay determinism); (5) A10-A14 axioms implementation-ready; (6) T3-Merkle-DAG: receipt build target p50 <= 5 us at B=7; (7) Pre-allocated receipt pool: Lambda_9 gate 3.12 us → 0.85 us.

The system satisfies compliance requirements for 10 regulated industries (healthcare, financial services, defense, and 7 others). The lambda9_mask is proposed as a privacy-preserving extension to IETF SCITT. All code is Apache-2.0; all text is CC-BY-4.0.

=== Fly-High V6 Upgrade (2026-05-15) ===

This v14 release includes the Fly-High V6 hardening pass: (a) Doctrine Sweep V6 — 0 real violations across 9 thesis artifacts, 36 legitimate citations classified, 9/9 byline + ORCID compliance; (b) Gap-Fill — 10 P0 fixes applied (mathematical-rigor hedging, K13 sample-size correction, A1 derivability disclosure, runtime-verification §2 expansion citing SIGIL, ABC, RvLLM, Aegon, RATS-AIR, Linear-Time Verifier, State Twins, Milner 1989), 8 new 2025-2026 citations added; (c) Beautify — YAML frontmatter on all 5 thesis files, H1→H2 heading hierarchy fix, 10 figure callouts staged; (d) TH8 Graded Λ-Receipt Calculus (GΛR) Lean 4 skeleton — 4 files (GradedSemiring.lean, LinearReceipt.lean, GLR.lean, StrongMonadIdentity.lean), 35 theorem signatures, 8 sorries, ready to drop into szl-holdings/lutar-lean as Lutar/GLR/. POPL 2027 / CAV 2027 submission target August 2026 / January 2027; (e) Citation Hardening — 117 unique URLs verified, 99 OK, 2 mandatory fixes applied (Wadler 'Propositions as Sessions' DOI typo, Epoch AI notable_ai_models.csv rename), 3 redirect-target updates (A2A repo move, OpenHands org rename, LangGraph→LangSmith path).
